summary:
Revised Production Implementation Plan (Revision 3) incorporating granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and category-specific operational properties:
- Strict RBAC Visibility & Creation Authority:
  * Simple Dual-Role Categories (Gym, Salon, Retail POS, Education, Freelance): ONLY the 'Owner' can access the 'Équipe' screen and create/manage staff members; regular 'Staff' are strictly locked out of the screen, payroll records, and creation actions.
  * Multi-Role Operational Categories (BTP, Agency, Auto Garage, Logistics, Manufacturing, Medical, Legal, Agriculture, Trading, Real Estate): Access is granted to the Owner AND team-management roles (e.g. Conducteur de Travaux, Chef d'Atelier, Chef de Projet, Dispatcher Hub, Chef de Culture, Médecin Chef, Associé).
- Vertical-Specific Specialized Properties in StaffModal:
  * Medical: Ordre des Médecins registration, medical specialty, prescription signing authority.
  * BTP Construction: Chantier assignment, CACOBATPH registration, site safety certification.
  * Logistics: Assigned vehicle & plate, Driving license category (B, C, D), delivery zone/wilayas.
  * Manufacturing: Assigned workstation/machine (CNC, assembly, QC), safety lockout training.
  * Agriculture: Concession parcel assignment, dairy milking parlor slot, tractor license.
  * Auto Garage: Repair bay assignment, technical specialization (mechanical, electrical, body).
  * Real Estate: Carte professionnelle, exclusive mandate negotiation authority.
  * Legal/Notary: Bar association registration number, sworn clerk signing clearance.
  * Trading/POS: Assigned cash register / depot, cash drawer limit.
  * Salon/Gym: Stylist chair / fitness studio assignment, commission percentages.
- Exhaustive edge-case safeguards, trilingual parity (FR/AR RTL/EN), and 100% reuse of Atrium's existing UI system.
